claims.claim: One round has the exact form T(p)=reverse(p_i : i in D) followed by (p_i : i not in D), where D={i>=2 : p_i<p_{i-1}} and both subsequences otherwise retain index order.
claims.evidence: Write D={d_1<...<d_k}. The marking scan queues exactly p_{d_1},...,p_{d_k}. Processing that queue moves each successive item ahead of all previously moved items, so the moved prefix is p_{d_k},...,p_{d_1}. Removing those items does not change the relative order of any unmarked pair, proving the displayed formula. The checker independently compared this formula with literal sequential MoveToFront operations on every permutation through n=9.
claims.search_method: Direct derivation from the specified marking and MoveToFront semantics, followed by exhaustive finite comparison on all 409113 permutations of orders 1 through 9.

claims.claim: There is an exact reduction of every maximum-element phase to parallel deletion in a word. Once i+1,...,n are fixed, write the active prefix as L i R. Define A(r_1...r_s)=(r_j : 2<=j<=s and r_{j-1}<r_j). The number of further rounds until i is fixed is h(R)=min{t:A^t(R) is empty}.
claims.evidence: The value i cannot be marked because every active predecessor is smaller. If R=(r_1,...,r_s), then r_1 is marked since r_1<i, while r_j for j>=2 is unmarked exactly when r_{j-1}<r_j. All marked elements move left of i and all unmarked elements preserve order, so the new right word is exactly A(R), independently of L. The already-fixed increasing suffix remains fixed. Induction gives A^t(R), and i is fixed exactly when this word is empty. The checker verified both the one-step recurrence and the resulting phase duration at every permutation state through n=9.
claims.search_method: Symbolic fixed-suffix invariant and induction, plus exhaustive exact phase checks for all permutation states through n=9.

claims.claim: If W(n) is the worst-case number of nontrivial rounds, then W(n)<=n(n-1)/2. Consequently no permutation family requires omega(n^2) rounds.
claims.evidence: Fixed maxima never become unfixed. At the start of the phase for i, its right word has at most i-1 entries. Every application of A to a nonempty word omits at least its first entry, so its extinction time is at most its length. Assigning length zero to already-fixed maxima, the phases partition all nontrivial rounds and give W(n)<=sum_{i=2}^n(i-1)=n(n-1)/2. Hence every family's round count divided by n^2 is bounded above by 1/2, ruling out little-omega(n^2). Exact enumeration through n=9 also satisfied the bound.
claims.search_method: Phase decomposition using the independently proved Claim 1 invariant; finite exhaustive sanity check through n=9.

claims.claim: For p_n=(n,1,2,...,n-1) and n>=3, at least n-1+floor((sqrt(8(n-1)+1)-1)/2) rounds are required.
claims.evidence: Define B_0=empty and B_{m+1}=(m+1)T(B_m). Induction with Claim 0 gives T^t(p_n)=B_t,n,t+1,...,n-1 for 0<=t<=n-1, so fixing n takes n-1 rounds and leaves B_{n-1},n. For m=n-1>=2, B_m=mR and A(B_m)=A(R), hence h(B_m)=h(R). The monotone-stack deletion-label recurrence shows by induction that, when m=q(q+1)/2+r with 0<=r<=q, the maximum deletion label of B_m is q; thus h(B_m)=q=floor((sqrt(8m+1)-1)/2). This supplies q additional rounds. The exact checker independently compared iterative and stack extinction times exhaustively through order 9 and checked the family and triangular-height law for every 3<=n<=500 using integer square roots.
claims.witness: The symbolic witness family is p_n=(n,1,2,...,n-1); for example, p_6=(6,1,2,3,4,5) takes 12 rounds, exceeding the claimed lower bound 7.
claims.search_method: Induction on the explicit B_m trace and monotone-stack deletion labels, supplemented by exact integer stress testing for every n from 3 through 500.

claims.claim: Under the zero-no-op-round convention, the exact worst-case values for n=1,...,9 are 0,1,3,6,9,12,18,21,26.
claims.evidence: The checker enumerated every permutation in S_n for each 1<=n<=9, first confirmed that the literal marking implementation and Claim 0's round map agree on every state, and then computed exact distances to the identity while rejecting nonidentity cycles. The resulting maxima were exactly 0,1,3,6,9,12,18,21,26. Because all n! starting permutations were covered for each n, the enumeration supplies both upper bounds and attaining lower bounds.
claims.witness: For n=1 use (1); for each 2<=n<=8, (n,1,2,...,n-1) attains the stated maximum; for n=9, (3,9,4,5,1,2,6,7,8) attains 26.
claims.search_method: Complete exact enumeration of all 409113 permutations across n=1,...,9, using integer tuple transformations only.

target_evidence: The exact target asks for an asymptotically tight worst-case round count and particularly asks whether a family can require little-omega(n^2) rounds. Claim 2 rigorously answers the highlighted subquestion negatively via W(n)<=n(n-1)/2. However, Claim 3 is only an asymptotically linear lower bound, and Claim 4 supplies only finite values, so there is no matching asymptotic lower bound or otherwise tight classification of W(n). The draft's final writeup explicitly acknowledges this remaining gap and labels its resolution PARTIAL. Therefore the work is valid material partial progress, and the claimed resolution is accurate rather than overstated or understated.
